dogecoin.text: NEIN NEIN NEIN! Elon Musk is a crypto loser, Dogecoin will fail! RESPECT MAH AUTHORITAH! You're just a bunch of clueless fanboys riding Musk's coattails! Screw you guys, I'm going home!
Elon Musk's Dogecoin predictions are as useless as a Cheesy Poof without cheese!
